maria_docs: FYI a customer reported our Console dashboard embed 404s when loaded inside a partner site. Quick triage: iframe blocked by CSP and sample trace_id format is wrong. tariq_eng: Which file? I can patch the snippet. maria_docs: docs/console/examples/embed-dashboard.html and dashboard/samples/trace-to-dashboard.yaml. iframe uses src=https://console.redwood.ai/embed/dashboard?sample=trace; CSP now has frame-ancestors 'self'. zoe_web: Two fixes: 1) update docs to recommend embeddable widget (postMessage) + signed snapshot tokens, 2) add an Nginx example for customers who control CSP. I'll draft widget snippet. tariq_eng: I'll update YAML to use a 32-hex trace_id and add a short migration block on the page showing old vs new. Example diff: `trace_id: 123e4567e89b12d3a456426655440000` maria_docs: Also call out cost impact: live embeds increase read rates. Add a sentence in cost-breakdown.md. ci-bot: Linkcheck failed: docs/console/examples/embed-dashboard.html -> 404 in preview build 3621. Created issue #804. zoe_web: Widget snippet (short): `
` will be in the PR. tariq_eng: Opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210 (embed + YAML + migration note). Includes Nginx sample and cost callout. maria_docs: Thanks. Can someone add a tiny Puppeteer smoke test that verifies embed URL responds 200 and CSP has frame-ancestors? If test fails, preview should warn. zoe_web: I can add the test in a follow-up PR. maria_docs: Final checklist: update samples, add migration note, widget snippet in examples, cost note, CI smoke test follow-up. Target merge today. :white_check_mark:
